description: Fetches product data from Kroger.com product pages using browser automation to handle anti-bot protections. Extracts product name, price, UPC, brand, description, images, and availability.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_product: Fetch a single product by URL or UPC; requires url or upc parameter; 参数: url, upc; 必填: 无
  - search_products: Search for products by query; requires query parameter; 参数: query; 必填: query

url.description: Full Kroger product page URL (used by get_product). Example: https://www.kroger.com/p/simple-truth-organic-kombucha-ginger/0001111087699

upc.description: Product UPC code (used by get_product as alternative to url). Example: 0085707500712

query.description: Search query string (used by search_products). Example: organic kombucha
